alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Express crosses Chenab and India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge at 100 kmph
bullets: India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge (Anji Bridge) on the Katra‑Banihal section, constructed by Indian Railways under the Ministry of Railways
Vande Bharat Express achieved a speed of 100 kmph while traversing both the world’s highest Chenab Bridge and the newly built Anji Bridge, setting the operational speed record for the section

alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Trains Cross India's First Cable‑Stayed Railway Bridge at 100 km/h on Kashmir Rail Link
bullets: India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge – Anji Bridge on the 111 km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, built by Indian Railways (Ministry of Railways)

Vande Bharat Express trains 26401 & 26404 successfully crossed Anji Bridge (and Chenab Rail Bridge) at a permissible speed of 100 km/h, marking the first high‑speed trial on this inaugural cable‑stayed structure

alert_news.title: Kumkum Mohod wins India's first women's individual recurve gold at Asian Games
bullets: First Indian woman to clinch gold in the individual women's recurve archery event at the Asian Games (2026).
Victory achieved by 17‑year‑old Kumkum Mohod in a shoot‑off against South Korea, marking India's inaugural gold in this discipline.

alert_news.title: Mumbai Port's Jawahar Dweep Becomes India's First Plastic-Free Oil Terminal
bullets: Jawahar Dweep Marine Oil Terminal (Butcher Island) off Mumbai becomes India's first oil terminal to eliminate single‑use plastics.
Mumbai Port Authority, under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, implemented the plastic‑free policy across the 5‑berth terminal 4 km offshore.

alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Crosses Chenab, Anji Bridges At 100 kmph As Katra‑Banihal Train Speed Limit Raised
bullets: First train to cross the world’s highest railway bridge (Chenab) and India’s first cable‑stayed railway bridge (Anji) at 100 km/h.
Speed test conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the maximum permissible speed from 75 km/h to 100 km/h.
Vande Bharat Express (train numbers 26401/26404) performed the run on 2 Oct 2025.

alert_news.title: Vande Bharat Express Sets First 100 kmph Run Across Chenab and Anji Bridges
bullets: First time a Vande Bharat Express crossed the world’s highest railway bridge (Chenab) and India’s first cable‑stayed railway bridge (Anji) at 100 km/h.
The speed test was on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the maximum permissible speed from 75 to 100 km/h.

alert_news.title: India Launches First AI Satellite MOI‑1A; Space Image Processing Tech
bullets: India’s first orbital computing satellite, MOI‑1A, launched by Hyderabad‑based TechMeToSpace on SpaceX’s Transporter‑18 mission.
MOI‑1A is a 13‑kg, 6U satellite with 120‑W power that processes images and data in orbit using AI, sending only useful information to Earth.
This launch makes India the fourth country globally to possess orbital computing capability after the United States, the European Union and China.
